Hi, Adisa. It's Rebecca Kwon. Ol'm calling because we've
just completed development of a new fragrance line for
J.M. Scents Incorporated, and now I need models of the
bottles they'll be packaged in. Could you make 3-D prints
of the perfume bottles, based on my digital renderings?
The problem is that we have a very tight timeline. oThe
client review is at the end of the week, so the bottles need
to be ready by the day the clients start their review. Ol'll be
happy to pay extra if you can make this project a priority.
